description: This file contains global exception handlers for a FastAPI application, including handling HTTP exceptions, validation errors, and generic exceptions, with structured JSON responses and logging.

methods.name: JSONResponse _problem_response(status_code: int, detail: Any, *, extra: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a JSONResponse with a structured payload following the problem schema, explicitly setting content type.

methods.name: JSONResponse http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException)
methods.description: Handles Starlette/FastAPI HTTPException, logs warning, and returns structured JSON error response.

methods.name: JSONResponse validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError)
methods.description: Handles Pydantic validation errors, logs info, and returns validation error details in JSON.

methods.name: JSONResponse generic_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Handles unexpected exceptions, logs exception with stack trace, and returns a sanitized error message.
